meta_title: Begas Car Key | Car Key Locksmith Newcastle
meta_description: Begas Car Key in Newcastle specialises in car key replacement, coding and emergency lockout services. Fast response, competitive rates. Call now.
hero_eyebrow: Fast Car Key Replacement — Emergency Lockouts Welcome
hero_subhead: We cut, code and replace car keys on the spot. Most jobs done within the hour, any day of the week.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to replacement keys and remote coding, we handle every car key problem quickly and affordably.

services.title: Emergency Car Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your car? We arrive fast and get you back inside without damage. Available 24/7 for breakdown situations.

services.title: Car Key Replacement
services.desc: Lost your keys or need a spare? We cut and code new keys to your vehicle's specifications on site.

services.title: Remote Key Coding
services.desc: Faulty or dead remote? We reprogram and repair key fobs to get your central locking working again.

services.title: Spare Car Keys
services.desc: Get a spare cut and programmed as backup. Saves you time and stress if your main key goes missing.

services.title: Transponder Key Programming
services.desc: Modern cars need programmed transponder keys. We handle coding for all security systems and vehicle makes.

services.title: Vehicle Access Solutions
services.desc: Damaged lock cylinder or ignition switch? We diagnose the problem and repair or replace as needed.

about_pullquote: We got fed up seeing people charged a fortune for a simple car key.
about_para_1: Begas Car Key has been helping Newcastle drivers for over 15 years. Started as a mobile locksmith service, we've grown into one of the most trusted car key specialists in the region. We invest in the latest coding equipment and training so you're never caught short if your key fails or you're locked out.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up fast, fixing the problem right, and charging honestly. We work on everything from old mechanical keys to the latest smart keys and proximity fobs. Repeat customers come back because we're reliable, we're local, and we don't overcharge.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a broken key fob and needed it sorted same day before work. Phoned Begas and they were here within 45 minutes. New remote coded and working perfectly. Really helpful bloke, fair price, no faffing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Locked myself out of my car in the Tesco car park on a Saturday afternoon. Called in a panic and they arrived in under an hour. Got me back in the car without any damage. Absolute lifesaver. Will definitely use again if needed.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: Lost my car keys and needed a replacement fast. Begas came out, cut a new key and programmed it all on the van. Cost was reasonable compared to the dealership quote. Professional and efficient. Top service.
reviews.author: Michael P.
